g.text: The network starts most conversations, but the heavy ones are started from outside

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: Inside hosts initiate 79.5% of sessions; sessions started from outside carry about twice the bytes per session, and loopback sessions carry the most

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: (1.7 MB each on average). Source: cap_20260920_111416/112321/112821/113321.pcap (4 files, 17.2 min; two continuous blocks of 192 s and 842 s). One-way

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: byte convention; loopback and non-IP traffic are handled per the data-convention note. Time-based statements are limited to those two blocks.
